authority.user_request: Resolve the issues found given in .txt file.
authority.interpretation: Engineering remediation includes development-only model simulation of the already proposed P1 candidate. It does not approve startup policy or authorize official A2/hardware.

candidate: P1 existing projected Slotine-Li static-midpoint reference; no tuning
initial_state: physical joint midpoint; qd=0; z=-Ko*M(q)*qd; dhat=0 at physical time -0.156
control: Existing gains; static qmid reference. Update once per Delta, project command onto physical torque box, hold actual applied torque for all RK4 stages. DOB receives that exact applied torque.
clock: One signed physical clock, disturbance evaluated at original physical t with t_ref=0; observer elapsed=t+T_pre; no reset at zero.

stop_criteria.position: abs(q-qmid)<=0.01 rad per joint throughout attempted hold
stop_criteria.velocity: abs(qd)<=0.02 rad/s per joint throughout attempted hold
stop_criteria.torque: abs(actual held tau)<=tau_max; no ideal clamp or reaction torque
stop_criteria.state: finite state and original physical h,psi1,speed,manipulability checks at retained stage/end samples
stop_criteria.observer: post-control diagnostic excess max(abs(d-dhat)-varpi)<=0 Nm at retained stages/end samples; no enlarged bounds
stop_criteria.on_first_failure: Stop that cell after retaining the first failed substep and dense-interpolant diagnostics; apply no additional torque or state update. Other predeclared C4 cells are independent numerical comparisons, never retuning.

continuous_check.method: For every attempted RK4 substep, find all component extrema of its standard cubic continuous extension on theta in [0,1]; check q deviation and qd limits at endpoints and stationary roots. Also check RK4 stage samples.
continuous_check.claim: Extrema of a numerical interpolant only. No verified ODE error enclosure, interval state box or continuous-time safety proof is inferred. An observed violation suffices to reject this development candidate.

actual_endpoint: At completed zero endpoint, or at actual simulated abort time, evaluate measured q,qd,z,dhat,varpi,h,psi1,speed,manipulability,previous applied torque and complete 43-row hard QP. Abort-time checks cannot qualify a missing zero endpoint.
